tools.name: search_ai_monks
tools.description: Search monk profiles and pending research candidates by name/handle, provenance, language, platform and region. Excludes illustrated/watercolor storytelling channels. Paginated; latest single-platform audience order by default; optional sampled-video views or reported three-month USD gross-revenue o

tools.name: get_ai_monk
tools.description: Retrieve one exact directory profile ID, its complete research record and referenced sources. Includes pending candidates with their directory_scope, identity conflicts and unknowns. Illustrated channels are excluded; candidate inclusion does not confirm AI production or video format.

tools.name: ai_monk_index_stats
tools.description: Return directory record/source counts, AI status counts and snapshot methodology. Metadata separates the full research archive from directory coverage. Directory counts include evidence-reviewed video personas and pending research candidates; illustrated channels are excluded. AI status counts do no

tools.name: top_formats
tools.description: Observed AI monk video samples ranked by latest dated public views, with title, duration, upload date and structure_summary (format, hook and script pattern). Optional account_id. Views are sampled-video observations, not channel totals.

tools.name: how_they_monetize
tools.description: Offers (type, name, listed or base price, currency, URL), separate localized presentment observations, seller counters, creator revenue claims and revenue observations for AI monk accounts, plus counts by offer type. Optional account_id. Prices are not orders; claims are unaudited.

tools.name: winning_playbooks
tools.description: Source-linked playbooks published by successful AI monk creators (e.g. Yang Mun by Shalev): script formula, winning hooks with reported views, voice, posting cadence, funnel to product and monetization. Creator claims are unaudited.
